name: Lawful basis for processing
description: Ensure all personal data processing has a lawful basis such as consent, contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest, or public interest.

name: Transparency and privacy notices
description: Provide clear, accessible, and timely privacy notices to data subjects regarding the purpose and use of their data.

name: Data minimization
description: Collect only the minimum personal data necessary for the specific purpose.

name: Accuracy and rectification
description: Ensure data is accurate and kept up-to-date, and provide mechanisms for correction.

name: Storage limitation
description: Retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the intended purpose.

name: Security safeguards
description: Implement technical and organizational measures to ensure integrity, confidentiality, and availability of data.

name: Registration with ODPC
description: Data controllers and processors must register with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner before processing data.

name: Data subject rights enablement
description: Enable rights of data subjects, including access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction, and portability.

name: Sensitive data protection
description: Apply additional safeguards when processing sensitive personal data such as health, biometric, or children’s data.

name: Cross-border data transfer compliance
description: Ensure personal data is only transferred outside Kenya where adequate safeguards or approvals are in place.

name: Breach notification
description: Notify the ODPC and affected data subjects of personal data breaches without undue delay.

name: Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA)
description: Conduct DPIAs before initiating high-risk data processing activities.

name: Privacy by design and default
description: Embed privacy controls into systems and services by default, ensuring compliance throughout the data lifecycle.

name: Accountability and governance
description: Maintain records, assign data protection officers (where applicable), and demonstrate compliance with the Act.
